notes: Build78 Emergency Kill Switch is a diagnostic containment release for the Chrome-wide freeze/memory incident. The shipped extension has no background service worker, no content scripts, no permissions, no host permissions, and no web-accessible runtime resources. The ZIP contains only manifest.json, icons, and the dormant update-manager artifact required by the release packager; update-manager.js is not referenced by the manifest and cannot execute. This release intentionally disables all Decrypter functionality so browser stability can be isolated from extension runtime execution.
